source: Saratoga Municipal Code Chapter 15 Zoning Regulations (library.municode.com/ca/saratoga), City of Saratoga 2040 General Plan, and Housing Element. See also: https://library.municode.com/ca/saratoga/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=CH15ZORE and https://www.saratoga.ca.us/656/2040-General-Plan
notes: Saratoga is predominantly a low-density single-family residential community. The R-1 district has multiple sub-zones defined by minimum lot size (10,000 to 40,000 sq ft). The general maximum residential density for multi-family and mixed-use is 20 du/ac (Section 15-19), with the C-N(RHD) overlay requiring a minimum of 30 du/ac. Single-family zones (A, HR, R-1 variants, R-OS) allow 1 dwelling per lot at their respective minimum lot sizes. Density in du/ac is derived from minimum lot size.

A.description: Agricultural District. Large-lot single-family residential and agricultural uses. Minimum lot size is approximately 1 acre (43,560 sq ft). One dwelling unit per lot.

R-1-40000.description: Single-Family Residential (40,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot. Equivalent to approximately 1.09 du/ac. Front setback 30 ft, max lot coverage 35%.

R-1-20000.description: Single-Family Residential (20,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot. Equivalent to approximately 2.18 du/ac.

R-1-15000.description: Single-Family Residential (15,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot. Equivalent to approximately 2.9 du/ac. Standard lot 100 ft wide x 125 ft deep. Front setback 25 ft, max lot coverage 50%.

R-1-12500.description: Single-Family Residential (12,500 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot. Equivalent to approximately 3.48 du/ac.

R-1-10000.description: Single-Family Residential (10,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot. Equivalent to approximately 4.36 du/ac. Standard lot 85 ft wide x 115 ft deep. Front setback 25 ft, max lot coverage 60%.

HR.description: Hillside Residential District. For hillside areas with slopes of 10% or greater. Single-family residential, one dwelling per lot. Larger lots required due to terrain; reduced net site area for slopes over 10%.

R-OS.description: Residential Open Space District. Very low density residential with significant open space preservation. Primarily for conservation and limited single-family use.

R-M.description: Residential Multi-Family District. Allows multi-family residential development up to 20 du/ac per Section 15-19 of the municipal code.

P-A.description: Professional Administrative Office District. Allows office uses; mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

C-N.description: Commercial Neighborhood District. Neighborhood-serving commercial. Mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

C-N(RHD).description: Commercial Neighborhood - Residential High Density Overlay. Amended by Ordinance 324 (Dec 2014) to require a minimum density of 30 du/ac. Intended for higher-density housing near commercial services.

C-V.description: Commercial Visitor District. Visitor-oriented commercial uses. Mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

CH-1.description: Commercial Historic 1 District (Saratoga Village Specific Plan area). Commercial uses with potential mixed-use residential up to 20 du/ac.

CH-2.description: Commercial Historic 2 District (Saratoga Village Specific Plan area). Commercial uses with potential mixed-use residential up to 20 du/ac.

M-U.description: Mixed Use District. Allows a mix of commercial and residential uses. Residential density up to 20 du/ac per Section 15-19.

MU-HD.description: Mixed Use High Density District. Higher-density mixed-use zone allowing 30 to 40 du/ac. Created to accommodate housing element requirements.

A AP/OS.description: Agricultural District with Agricultural Preserve/Open Space overlay. Large-lot single-family and agricultural uses; 1 dwelling per lot.

CN.description: Commercial Neighborhood District. Neighborhood-serving commercial; mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

CV.description: Commercial Visitor District. Visitor-oriented commercial; mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

HR AP/OS.description: Hillside Residential with Agricultural Preserve/Open Space overlay. Single-family residential on hillside lots; one dwelling per lot.

MU-PD.description: Mixed Use - Planned Development. Mixed-use planned development; residential density up to 20 du/ac per approved plan.

None.description: Unzoned or unclassified parcel. No zoning designation assigned.

PA.description: Professional Administrative Office District. Office uses; mixed-use residential permitted up to 20 du/ac.

R-1-10.description: Single-Family Residential (10,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot; approximately 4.36 du/ac.

R-1-10 PC.description: Single-Family Residential (10,000 sq ft min lot) with Planned Community overlay. One dwelling per lot; approximately 4.36 du/ac.

R-1-10 SS.description: Single-Family Residential (10,000 sq ft min lot) with Small Subdivision overlay. One dwelling per lot; approximately 4.36 du/ac.

R-1-12.description: Single-Family Residential (12,500 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot; approximately 3.48 du/ac.

R-1-15.description: Single-Family Residential (15,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot; approximately 2.9 du/ac.

R-1-20.description: Single-Family Residential (20,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot; approximately 2.18 du/ac.

R-1-40.description: Single-Family Residential (40,000 sq ft minimum lot). One dwelling per lot; approximately 1.09 du/ac.

R-1-40 AP/OS.description: Single-Family Residential (40,000 sq ft min lot) with Agricultural Preserve/Open Space overlay. One dwelling per lot; approximately 1.09 du/ac.

R-1-40 PC.description: Single-Family Residential (40,000 sq ft min lot) with Planned Community overlay. One dwelling per lot; approximately 1.09 du/ac.

R-M-3.description: Residential Multi-Family 3. Multi-family residential up to 20 du/ac per Section 15-19 of the municipal code.

R-M-4.description: Residential Multi-Family 4. Multi-family residential up to 20 du/ac per Section 15-19 of the municipal code.

R-M-5.description: Residential Multi-Family 5. Multi-family residential up to 20 du/ac per Section 15-19 of the municipal code.

R-OS AP/OS.description: Residential Open Space with Agricultural Preserve/Open Space overlay. Very low density with open space preservation.

R-OS*.description: Residential Open Space (special designation). Very low density residential with significant open space preservation.
